title: ConvoHop docs pipeline language
description: One SDK language in the docs pipeline, stored as docs/languages/<id>/language.json. Paths are relative to that directory. Commands are argument vectors that docgen runs from the repository root without a shell. See docs/docs-pipeline.md.

id.description: The language's directory name under docs/languages and docs/site.

order.description: Navigation sort key. Ties sort by id.

status.description: preview until the language's SDK is released and supported.

codeFence.description: Info string of the code blocks that docgen renders for this language, such as ts.

testedFences.description: Info strings that quickstarts may use only through include fences, so every code block in the language is tested. Must contain codeFence.

regionComment.description: The line-comment token before #region and #endregion markers: // gives // #region <name>, # gives # #region <name>, which formatters such as Black keep. Empty where #region is itself a directive, as in C#.

snippetRoots.description: Directories whose files quickstarts may include. Their tests must compile or run every file.

packages.description: Documented packages in display order. The extractor prints them in this order.

quickstarts.description: Topic IDs from tools/docgen/docgen.config.mjs that have a quickstarts/<topic>.md file. Pages follow the configured topic order.

operations.description: File name of the operation map (operation-map.schema.json) in the language directory, such as operations.json.

command.description: Prints the packages' public surface (surface.schema.json, without $schema) on stdout and exits 0.

install.description: Installs the snippet tests' dependencies from a lockfile. Runs before command when docgen test gets --install.

command.description: Compiles every file under snippetRoots and runs their tests. Exits 0 on success.

name.description: The name users install or import, such as @convohop/server.

slug.description: File name of the package's reference page, docs/site/<language>/reference/<slug>.md.

layer.description: server packages use backend keys or operator tokens; client packages use user sessions.

source.description: The package's source directory, relative to the repository root.
